note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by the clerk, Mr. J. L. Rankin, on 5 May 1936. No division was contested; all the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Tyrone was fixed for Wednesday 3 June 1936 (Strabane Chronicle, 21 March 1936, p. 4; Belfast News-Letter, 17 March 1936, p. 12); no poll was needed where all seats were filled at nominations. Filed on 1936-06-03, the Tyrone polling day (previously filed under 1936-05-28, 6 Nov 2026). division inferred from the 31 May 1933 return (Mr. James Sheerin (Nationalist); Strabane Chronicle, 22 April 1933, p. 1); the Strabane Chronicle, 12 September 1936, p. 1 names the member as sitting in the new term (Strabane Board of Guardians, whose rural members were the rural district councillors, 8 September 1936; again 12 December 1936, p. 8). No nomination was received for Doorat (Derry Journal, 6 May 1936, p. 8); the retiring member was deemed re-elected. No co-option, vacancy or by-election for Doorat was reported in 1936. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
